s: May 17, 2025 - Amber Waves of Grain is a live album by American country music artist Merle Haggard with backing by The Strangers, released in 1985. It was Haggard's third live album in four years and was recorded at the Hollywood Star Theatre. It features a mix of Haggard's big hits and other, more obscure tracks.
